BiblicalUsage: Tel-harsha, also spelled Tel-charsha, was a place in Babylonia from which exiles returned with Zerubbabel. The children of Delaiah, Tobiah, and Nekoda came up from Tel-melah and Tel-harsha, but they could not shew their father's house, whether they were of Israel.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the men of Tel-harsha came home without proof of their fathers' house, and the record keeps their names anyway.
